acquisition: Public read-only curl downloads succeeded under auto-reviewed network escalation. Safe archive extraction allowed only regular relative files with no .. path. No archive code or TeX was executed.
archive_contents_scope: Source EM_PRD.tex, bibliography, table_ffs.tex, PDF figures. Full regular-file inventory retained. No raw configuration samples/covariance supplied among the inspected members.
explicit_data_link_check: Inspected main TeX and primary HTML/PDF for Appendix B/supplement and dataset links. Numerical table is directly included in main paper/source; no separate raw covariance link authenticated. References to other papers are not treated as its dataset. No unbounded repository search or author contact.
source_fit_disclosure: Published point extraction uses plateau/ground-state analysis, jackknife marginals and nonperturbative current normalization with its own scale fit. Separate source dipole/z-expansion/galster fits for radii and moments are NOT used here. Source scale-setting average physical nucleon mass is an input.
scope_limit: These are light-current elastic input data at one finite lattice spacing and volume, not a complete continuum all-flavor proton tensor.
